brief:
Israeli forces killed two Palestinians and wounded several others in the Gaza Strip on Thursday, according to IMEMC News. The deaths occurred as Israeli military operations continued across the coastal enclave despite a ceasefire agreement.

The incident marked a continuing pattern of violence in Gaza, where the territory remains under Israeli siege and blockade. Details on the circumstances of the deaths and the identities of those killed were not immediately provided.

title: Israeli fire kills two Palestinians in Gaza
